# WebMD

> > WebMD is a trusted digital health platform providing comprehensive medical information, disease guides, symptom checkers, and wellness resources for patients seeking evidence-based health education.

WebMD offers authoritative health information across hundreds of medical conditions, treatments, and wellness topics. The platform serves as a primary resource for patients researching diseases, understanding symptoms, and learning about treatment options, with content organized through dedicated health centers for major conditions.

## Key Topics

- Cardiovascular Disease
- Type 2 Diabetes
- Type 1 Diabetes
- Breast Cancer
- Depression
- Rheumatoid Arthritis
- Atrial Fibrillation
- Lupus
- Eczema
- Asthma
- Sleep Apnea
- Migraine
- Symptoms and Diagnosis
- Treatment Options
- Health Education

## Core Navigation

- [WebMD Homepage](https://www.webmd.com): WebMD homepage: trusted health information, medical news, and wellness resources.
- [All Health Topics](https://www.webmd.com/a-to-z-guides/health-topics): A-to-Z directory of health topics, conditions, and medical reference guides.

## Chronic Diseases & Conditions

- [Diabetes Center](https://www.webmd.com/diabetes/default.htm): Diabetes guide covering Type 1, Type 2, gestational diabetes, and management.
- [Heart Disease Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/heart-disease/default.htm): Heart disease guide covering symptoms, risk factors, conditions, and prevention.
- [Hypertension (High Blood Pressure) Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/hypertension-high-blood-pressure/default.htm): Hypertension guide covering causes, symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment options.
- [Arthritis and Joint Pain Center](https://www.webmd.com/arthritis/default.htm): Arthritis guide covering osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and joint pain management.
- [Lung Disease Respiratory Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/lung/default.htm): Lung disease guide covering respiratory conditions, symptoms, tests, and treatments.

## Cancer & Oncology

- [Oncology Center](https://www.webmd.com/cancer/default.htm): Cancer guide covering major types, symptoms, causes, diagnosis, and treatment.
- [Breast Oncology Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/breast-cancer/default.htm): Breast cancer information covering symptoms, diagnosis, stages, and treatment options.

## Mental Health & Neurological Conditions

- [Mental Health Disorders Center](https://www.webmd.com/mental-health/default.htm): Mental health guide covering disorders, symptoms, treatments, and resources.
- [Depression Center](https://www.webmd.com/depression/default.htm): Depression guide covering symptoms, medications, therapy options, and causes.
- [ADD and ADHD Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/add-adhd/default.htm): ADHD guide covering causes, diagnosis, symptoms, and treatments for children and adults.

## Autoimmune & Inflammatory Diseases

- [Lupus Center](https://www.webmd.com/lupus/default.htm): Lupus guide with symptoms, diagnosis testing, treatment, and disease education.
- [Crohn's Disease Center](https://www.webmd.com/ibd-crohns-disease/crohns-disease/default.htm): Crohn's Disease guide with symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, and complications.
- [Eczema - Atopic Dermatitis Center](https://www.webmd.com/skin-problems-and-treatments/eczema/default.htm): Eczema guide covering atopic dermatitis, symptoms, treatments, and skin care.

## Infectious & Circulatory Diseases

- [Atrial Fibrillation (AFib) Center](https://www.webmd.com/heart-disease/atrial-fibrillation/default.htm): AFib guide with symptoms, causes, diagnosis, and treatment options.
- [Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Center](https://www.webmd.com/dvt/default.htm): DVT guide with symptoms, causes, diagnosis tests, and treatment options.
- [AIDS and HIV Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/hiv-aids/default.htm): HIV/AIDS guide with transmission, prevention, safe sex, and treatment information.

## Allergies & Sensory Health

- [Allergies Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/allergies/default.htm): Comprehensive allergy information including symptoms, treatments, and testing.
- [Eye Care Center](https://www.webmd.com/eye-health/default.htm): Eye health guide covering vision conditions, LASIK surgery, and eye exams.
